==Overview==
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a {{Rarity|Exclusive}} {{LU}}. He is a [[Tournament|Tournament-exclusive]] (preceding [[Stitches]] and succeeding [[Caesar]]), only obtainable by clearing the tournament on the 99.00% ~ 99.89% ranking reward, with his shiny being the 99.90% ~ 100% ranking reward.

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
